segments.name: Managed Care
segments.description: Provides medical cost containment and managed care services for workers' compensation, automobile insurance, and group health insurance claims.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one reportable operating segment, managed care.

revenueModel.text: Insurance companies, TPAs, self-administered employers and government entities pay for patient management and network solutions services to manage medical costs.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives its revenues from providing patient management and network solutions services to payors of workers' compensation benefits, automobile insurance claims, and group health insurance benefits.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the Company effected a three-for-one forward stock split of its common stock.
changes.evidence: During fiscal year 2025, the Company effected a three-for-one forward stock split of its common stock.
